about: The chart's picture, in tiles the game shows under its marks (Game/Map/MapArt.cs). Redraw any tile at the same size and the game shows yours. The frame is the game's world frame (Lambert conformal, parallels 45N and 65N, centred 56N 5E; x east, z north, real metres). Tile t_<row>_<col>.png: row 0 is the northernmost, col 0 the westernmost. overview.png is the whole window at one sixth the size, shown when zoomed far out. overview_guide.png has the places of 793 marked: for drawing, not shown in the game.

legend.meadow: cleared land: fields and pasture about 800; the salt marsh's ground
legend.grass: heath and moor; the ground of peat and fen
legend.pale sand: beaches, bars and open dune sand

made: Bake/world/make_map_art.py from the world bake (level 2, 120 m), KK10 (1150 BP), ESA WorldCover 2021 and the scale-map bake's rivers and lakes
